notes.title: Lost Hope: Prologue - Update 09.11
notes.notes:
The Lost Hope: Prologue "Interim" update from September 11 is aimed at improving the gameplay with the existing story part. List of the main changes:

 Size. The overall size of the game has been significantly reduced (7.02 GB → 3.83 GB).
 Optimization. The amount of RAM used has been reduced by 15%, which has a positive effect on the gameplay.
 Appearance. The game has acquired even more realistic and pleasant graphics, which will allow you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere even more!
 Other. Among other things, the system of player interaction with the environment has also undergone changes, due to which the game cycle has acquired an additional cinematic quality!

notes.title: Lost Hope: Prologue Update July 19th
notes.notes:
The new version of Lost Hope: Prologue has undergone a large number of changes in all the most important aspects of the game. List of main changes made:

 Size. The overall size of the game has been reduced (7.74 GB → 7.02 GB).
 Optimization. The same test devices show better results in the new version of the game.
 Appearance. The game graphics have undergone a large number of positive changes. Meet completely updated game graphics!
 Bugs. Among other things, some game elements that could have a negative impact on the gameplay have been radically changed to make the gameplay as comfortable as possible.
